verdict.rationale: Workable documents in-product AI suggestions: candidate recommendations generated from your job ad, AI-assisted candidate search, and the Workable Agent, which screens and qualifies candidates into a shortlist. These are suggestions tied to recruiting actions, not general insights over your account data. The recommendations draw on an external 400M-profile pool rather than your own data. missing for 10: AI-generated analytics or insights over your own hiring data (e.g., AI in reports), detailed documentation of how suggestions are produced, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Receive AI-generated recommendations of qualified candidates based on your job ad from a pool of 400 million profiles.
The Workable Agent runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate against the spec - and hands your team an interview-ready shortlist.
Search yourself or use AI to find qualified candidates that match your specific requirements.
